_comment: Theia cron jobs — MERGE these into ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json's 'jobs' array (deploy.sh does it with a backup). All start DISABLED; enable only after per-layer smoke tests. API-free jobs (learn/backtest/evaluate) keep Theia productive when API budget is spent.

jobs.name: theia-discover-screen
jobs.prompt: Discover recent Solana pools via theia-dexdata.new_pools() and trending_pools(). FILTER: ONLY process tokens where pair.dexId contains "pump" OR "pump.fun" OR "pump_fun", AND liquidity_usd < $100,000 (memecoin range). SKIP tokens with "wrapped", "USD", "USDC", "SOL" in baseToken.symbol (established tokens — different dynamics). SKIP tokens where pair already exists in tokens table (dedup by mint). For each NEW token: 1) Call theia-chainrpc.token_creator(mint) → creator wallet (Helius RPC → Pump.fun API fallback). 2) Extract launch_ts from pair.pairCreatedAt (DexScreener). 3) Call theia-dexdata.pairs_by_token([mint]) → price, liquidity, volume. 4) Classify time_regime from pairCreatedAt using compute/time_regime.py. 5) Upsert to theia-store.upsert_token_v2() with all fields. 6) Record price to theia-store.record_price_snapshot(). 7) Run theia-screen-token for safety screening. Respect per-source budget. DexScreener throttle: 1 req/sec, batch enrich in groups of 30. Pump.fun API: throttle 1 req/sec (fallback only). Do NOT trade here.

jobs.name: theia-monitor
jobs.prompt: If theia-store.get_open_trades() is non-empty, run theia-monitor over the open book (stops/TP/trail/time + emergency rug exit). If there are no open positions, output [SILENT] and exit.

jobs.name: theia-backtest
jobs.prompt: API-FREE. Take draft/backtesting hypotheses from theia-store and run theia-backtest on STORED history (no live calls). Record results; update best metrics. If nothing to test, output [SILENT].

jobs.name: theia-learn
jobs.prompt: API-FREE fallback work. Advance the Solana curriculum via theia-learn-solana: research the next topic (or one a pending hypothesis needs), verify sources, drop a sourced input into 00-Inbox/_knowledge/ for the knowledge-curator. If budget for API-bound work is available and there is pending discovery/screening, prefer that instead.

jobs.name: theia-evaluate
jobs.prompt: Run theia-evaluate-expectancy across hypotheses with new closed results. Promote only on the gate (expectancy>0 AND profit_factor>1) beating random-entry on fresh out-of-sample data with n>=20. Escalate promotions to the human. Put a short digest in the final response — Hermes auto-delivers it to the origin channel.

jobs.name: theia-label-corpus
jobs.prompt: For all tokens in graduation_status='bonding' that are >2 hours old: check graduation via theia-dexdata.pairs_by_token([mint]). If token has Raydium/Orca/Meteora pool → label 'graduated'. If token meets death criteria (age >24h since launch AND no graduation, or price dropped >90% from ATH AND liquidity<200 AND volume<500) → label 'dead' with death_reason. Update via theia-store.update_graduation(). Then upsert labeled tokens to theia-store.upsert_corpus() with final_price_usd and final_liquidity_usd.

jobs.name: theia-task-runner
jobs.prompt: Run cron/task_runner.py --once to poll the task queue, resolve dependencies, and execute ready tasks. This drives all batch work (discovery, backtest, wallet enrichment) through the persistent queue. If no tasks ready, output [SILENT].

jobs.name: theia-wallet-pipeline
jobs.prompt: Poll latency-tolerant smart-money wallets (is_smart_money=1), capture new buys, screen (liq>$5k + price cap 1.5x), open PAPER trades for passing signals.

schedule.display: every 5 min — wallet signal capture + paper entry

jobs.name: theia-wallet-monitor
jobs.prompt: Check open paper positions, apply exit_engine (stop -35% / TP 2x-4x / 60m time stop), archive realized PnL.

schedule.display: every 5 min — paper position exit guard

jobs.name: theia-wallet-report
jobs.prompt: Format and deliver the daily wallet-pipeline digest (tracked wallets, signals, open/closed positions, forward expectancy/PF/win-rate) to the origin channel.

jobs.name: theia-wallet-discovery
jobs.prompt: Scrape GMGN leaderboard (winrate+pnl), profile new wallet candidates with latency-tolerance gate (train/test split n>=20), prune stale tracked wallets (no activity 14d).

jobs.name: theia-source2-discovery
jobs.prompt: Source-2 wallet discovery (ADDITIVE): scrape Dexscreener trending pools (h24/h6 up, liq>=30k, mcap<50M), fetch Birdeye top_traders, pre-filter (no bot tags, realizedPnl>0, trade>=5), then GATE via GMGN 7d wallet analytics (realized_profit_7d>0 AND tx30d<5000, blacklist bundler/dev seen on any token). Upsert passing wallets as is_smart_money=1 source='dex_trending'.

jobs.name: theia-pipeline-health
jobs.prompt: Run the read-only pipeline health watchdog and print its health report. Do not modify runtime state or deliver anything beyond normal cron output.

schedule.display: every 5 min — read-only pipeline health watchdog
